word.definition: Effrontery is a formal word that refers to bold shamelessness, or in other words an attitude or way of behaving that is both confident and  shocking or rude.

sports_fact.text: Muhammad Ali, hands shaking from Parkinson's, lit the Olympic flame in Atlanta in 1996 — a moment kept secret until he stepped from the shadows.

history.text: American Indian Wars: In Minnesota, 303 Dakota warriors are found guilty of rape and murder of whites and are sentenced to death. Thirty-eight are ultimately hanged and the others reprieved.
